create_ModifierInterface_subclass: create a subclass of ModifierInterface implementing its abstract lifecycle methods
test_initialized_property: test the initialized property of a ModifierInterface subclass returns True after initialize is called
test_finalized_property: test the finalized property of a ModifierInterface subclass returns True after finalize is called
run_initialize_modifier: run initialize on a ModifierInterface subclass with a State object and optional kwargs
run_finalize_modifier: run finalize on a ModifierInterface subclass with a State object and optional kwargs
run_update_event_modifier: run update_event on a ModifierInterface subclass with a State and Event object
